Developer Remarks: The Students and Trainers cards on the dashboard now open Add student / Add trainer (or the roster if the person cannot register people).
The edit-profile photo had two rings (the avatar's own plus an outer frame). One ring now; the picked or saved photo fills the circle.
The year list in the date picker opens on the current year; scroll up for older years.
Batch form has an Online class link field (Meet/Zoom/Teams). Students and trainers get a Join button on each class in the home schedule and the calendar. Needs the backend redeploy (migration V66).
Guardian name removed from the sign-up form.
Every back button is now the same 36px tile (login, app lock and playlists were the odd ones; the Attendance/Fees/Profile tabs now use the shared tile).

Could not reproduce a specific flash. Removed two causes: the 200ms theme cross-fade (it paints the previous palette) and the white page behind the app before the first frame in dark mode. Tell us the exact screen if it still happens.
Swipe left/right switches between the Students and Trainers tabs.
Dropdowns with more than 5 options show a search box.
Attendance has the back button top-left in this build; verified on screen.
Fees has the back button top-left in this build; verified on screen.
Guardian / parent phone is required when adding a student. Enforced in the app only; the server still accepts a student without one so older app builds keep working.
Remove on a trainer now takes them off the course (their features, batch scoping and batch seats too) instead of greying them out. Their account and other courses stay. Needs the backend redeploy.
Student and trainer photos are shown in the roster and on the edit form; a new photo chosen while editing is uploaded on save. Needs the backend redeploy.
Batch start and end dates cannot be before today; past days are greyed out in the calendar.
Measured the student form at phone width: first/last name; date of birth/age and phone boxes line up with their labels. Please send the device or screen size and a screenshot.
Every row on Academy Settings has its icon (checked against the prototype). Please retest on the latest build; send a screenshot if one is still missing.
A notification now has a check button that marks it read. There is no delete (decided with the product owner; the sheet asked for a delete button).
A daily job at 03:30 clears notifications older than 60 days (setting nest.notifications.retention-days). Needs the backend redeploy.

Not built. A course has a due day but nothing in the system uses it yet; there is no overdue logic to add a penalty to. Need to confirm: percent of what (the month's fee or the outstanding balance)? Recorded as a ledger entry that can be waived? Charged by a daily job the day after the due date?
The Everyone (students and trainers) option has an icon; verified on the Add Event screen.
Name fields block anything but letters and spaces and show a message. Letters from any language are allowed (Devanagari; Tamil and so on); not only A-Z. Same rule on the server.
Country code and number boxes share one height and line up (measured at 2x on the student form).
Full international code list (about 200 codes; includes Germany +49 and Australia +61).
The digits allowed follow the country code (India +91 takes 10) and a wrong length cannot be submitted. Checked on the server as well.
